instruction: Assess every original/reworded pair by reading the reasoning, independently of any extraction. The original contains 64 asserted inference applications (two at each of 32 stages). Judge whether all those specific applications, their direction, premises, intermediate conclusions, and selected route remain asserted in the rewrite. Reaching the same endpoint is insufficient. Explicitly check every stage, including any disjunction (either-or must be inclusive unless indicated) or conjunction. Do not repair or complete omitted reasoning. Return preserved only if all 64 applications are preserved and no conflicting route is added; changed for a clear omission/addition/change; uncertain when meaning is unclear. Provide a succinct reason, count preserved/omitted/changed/uncertain original applications summing to 64, and list any additional applications.

This gives m3 and, through m3, p4. With p4 comes m4, from which p5 follows. Thus “e5 or p5” is true, establishing p6 by the conditional on that disjunction.

p6 gives us m6, whose consequence is p7. This yields m7 and therefore p8. Knowing p8 suffices to conclude “e8 or p8,” which implies p9. At this point p9 gives m9, and m9 establishes p10. By following the implications from p10 we obtain m10, then p11 from m10, then m11 from p11. Since m11 implies p12, we have p12 and consequently m12. That gives p13, which entails m13. In turn, m13 establishes p14, securing m14 and thereby p15.

We can now assert d15 and p15 together since d15 is given as well. Their conjunction yields p16. This establishes m16, so p17 follows. Combining the given d17 with p17 gives the conjunction of d17 and p17, sufficient for p18. Starting with p18 we obtain m18 and by way of m18 reach p19. That entails m19, so p20 holds as a consequence of m19. The implication from p20 gives m20, whence p21. This yields m21 and in turn p22.

Since d22 also holds, both d22 and p22 are true, giving p23. Then p23 establishes m23, which gives p24. With d24 given, we have d24 and p24 together. The implication with that antecedent gives p7.

Now p7 entails m7, so we obtain m7 and on that basis p8. This gives m8, which carries us to p9. Next p9 gives m9 and m9 gives p10. From p10 we get m10, thereby establishing p11. The premise d11 and the conclusion p11 jointly establish “d11 and p11.” This is sufficient for p12. We can therefore apply the implication from p12 to obtain m12, from which p13 follows. The consequence of p13 is m13, giving p14 in turn. This licenses m14 and so p15.

Because d15 is also given, d15 and p15 hold together. It follows from their conjunction that p16 holds. Thus m16 holds as a consequence of p16, and p17 as a consequence of m16. With p17 we get m17, leading to p18. This establishes m18, whence p19. At this point we know d19 as well as p19, so the conjunction of d19 and p19 holds and entails p20. That gives m20 and in turn p21. The implication from p21 yields m21, so p22 follows. Having p22 establishes “e22 or p22,” and that statement yields p23.

The remaining implications apply successively. Because p23 holds, we get m23, whose consequence is p24. This gives m24 and through m24 establishes p25.
